Prioritization & Execution: Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.Your ExperienceExperience: 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a Saa S or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies. Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes. Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment. Organizational & Analytical Skills: Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements. Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support. Language:Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.Information about Palo Alto Networks At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Implements best practices for the planning function and partners with channels to ensure the best and necessary data to analyze and drive the business Participate in major go-to-market milestones to gain insight to key seasonal strategies and initiatives. Aligns OTB processes by channel to meet sales, margin, and inventory turn targets, Rolling Demand Plan and markdown plans. Ensures POs and Transfer orders are places accordingly. Support in-market stock position assuring the right volumes are available on DTCs business and Retail doors. Communicates delivery constraints, operational issues/opportunities. Flags irreconcilable issues to manager for problem solving and escalation as needed. Drives the development and roll-out of tools to support demand planning efforts and data collection defining and establishing “best in class” planning processes and driving strategic and continuous improvement activities Provides quarterly & seasonal historical data analysis & insight as inputs for future planning Leads demand planning monthly reporting, developing and monitoring KPIs to track forecasting accuracy and other key metrics (inventory aging and obsolescence).DEMAND PLANNING Use analytical, marketing, and sales data to effectively estimate future product demands. Duties include planning inventory flow, analyzing statistical data, and generating forecasting solutions.IMPORTATION Support Marketing Manager to build and control importation orders including promotional items Follow-up shipments and guide commercial teams on ruptures/overstock Control and manage depreciationKPIS Understand brand’s metrics and improve DOI KPI Keep track of brand’s fill rateMARKET ANALYSIS Support Marketing Manager gather and analyze constant information on the Market evolution, trends and competitors Price Analysis and Price Tables UpdatesCOMMERCIAL SUPPORT Develop monthly launch books to facilitate commercial presentation and negotiation with Retailers Touchpoint to Commercial team: send launch products and keep “order form” updated Prepare Special Sales support materialBUDGETS Support on Marketing Manager on building/revising sales forecastKey Competencies Functional Work Knowledge (Demand Planning, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Full Abilities Strong analytical profile, Results Oriented Acute attention to detail Ability to work in fast-paced, often-changing environment Ability to work well with cross functional teams Ability to take initiative and think out of the box Consumer and trends understandingProfile: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills Demonstrate potential in problem solving, negotiation, and analytical skills Strong organizational and time management skills; able to handle multiple priorities Team worker Enthusiasm and energyTechnical Skills: 2-year college degree with emphasis in business or finance Minimum 3-5 years of operations experience within a Consumer Products organization and with increasing degree of responsibility Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Power Point); ability to deliver strong, polished, effective Power Point presentations Fluent Portuguese and English mandatory

Ability to work independently and in a team environment. 3-7 years as a CRAWhy Join? Opportunity to join a globally recognised life sciences company through Kelly’s FSP model. Work with international experts on high-impact projects. Gain global exposure and expand your clinical knowledge. Be part of a collaborative, growth-focused work culture. Pipeline opportunity with anticipated hiring in the near future, apply early to be considered once the position is formally approved and released.

description:

Sobre o Inventta ICTVocê já pensou em colocar seu talento a serviço da ciência, tecnologia e inovação no Brasil?O Inventta ICT é um Instituto de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação dedicado a impulsionar a pesquisa científica aplicada ao setor farmacêutico. Nosso foco está no desenvolvimento de medicamentos de alta complexidade e em soluções à saúde de forma segura e sustentável, com integridade, criatividade, colaboração, qualidade e compromisso com a sustentabilidade, promovemos conexões e desenvolvemos projetos de PD&I de alto impacto.Contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada e acreditamos na colaboração como chave para gerar valor e acelerar a inovação em saúde, com forte compromisso com a evolução biotecnológica no país.O Dia a Dia Da OportunidadeNesta posição você será responsável por desenvolver, promover e implementar projetos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de inovações em novos produtos farmacêuticos, sintéticos e biotecnológicos (incrementais e radicais), atuando desde a pesquisa científica, tecnológica e/ou patentária, e, no desenvolvimento de formulações e processos, bem como o suporte aos estudos regulatórios necessários para o registro junto aos órgãos competentes.· Atuar na prospecção, ideação e avaliação de projetos estratégicos, explorando oportunidades de propriedade intelectual e bases científicas, elaborando relatórios e estudos de viabilidade. Conduzir discussões técnicas sobre inovações incrementais e radicais em conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais.· Realizar levantamentos bibliográficos e científicos para elaboração de dossiês de desenvolvimento de produtos; definir formulações, processos e escalonamento de lotes para estudos pré-clínicos e pilotos. Suporte aos estudos de pré-formulação, métodos analíticos e estabilidade exploratória.· Propor soluções para desafios técnicos dos projetos, acompanhar planos de ação, apoiar a seleção de fabricantes de insumos e a definição de materiais de embalagem, além do suporte a captação de fomentos para pesquisa.· Elaborar e revisar documentos técnicos, procedimentos operacionais padrão e relatórios em conformidade com as boas práticas de fabricação e desenvolvimento. Participar de treinamentos, eventos e orientar tecnicamente pares e equipes, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimentos.O que esperamos que você tenha para concorrer a oportunidade:Ensino superior completo em Farmácia.Experiência prévia em Desenvolvimento Farmacotécnico e/ou Analítico.Desenvolvimento de Produtos Farmacêuticos, Pesquisa Científica e Inovação.Desejável familiaridade com patentes, fomentos e gestão de projetos.Diferencial pós-graduação ou especialização na área.Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, para elaboração de relatórios técnicos.Inglês avançadoRemuneração, Pacote de Benefícios:Remuneração: compatível com o mercado. Benefícios: plano médico extensivo aos dependentes, plano odontológico; restaurante no local, vale alimentação, vale transporte, previdência privada, Total Pass e Happy Day Off de Aniversário.Horário e Local de Trabalho:

title: Regional manager, tender management and pricing
description:
Nova oportunidade para Regional manager, tender management and pricing em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

TheRegional Manager, Tender Management and Pricingis responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.Responsibilities Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions. Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs. Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions. Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities. Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies. Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.). Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions. Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers. Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness. Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes. Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices. Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions. Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes. Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams. All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required. Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required. Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced). 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding. Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks. Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely. Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities. Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information. Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.). Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory. Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards. Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments. Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel. Educational Background:Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields. Communication Skills:Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Customer-Centric:Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals. Location:Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.Preferred Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, Lo Ra, satellite communication, and antennas. Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil. Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial Io T, or connected mobility verticals. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and standard productivity software. Spanish language skills a plus.About Quectel Quectel is a global Io T solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.Life at Quectel LATAM At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.Industries & Applications Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:Smart Metering & Utilities —Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions. Asset Tracking & Logistics —Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture —Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Smart Cities & Infrastructure —Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring. Industrial Io T & Automation —Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring. Connected Mobility & Automotive —Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T —Connected appliances, energy management, security.Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus —Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).Explore Quectel — Links & Resources We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. Position SummaryWe are seeking a highly capable and versatileLATAM HR Operations & Local Representativeto join our growing team in Brazil. In this dual-capacity role, you will serve as the strategic and operational HR lead for our Latin America (LATAM) region—specifically covering Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Mexico—while simultaneously acting as our official local legal representative for our corporate entity registration in Brazil. The ideal candidate will manage all end-to-end HR operations across the region, steer local administrative functions in Brazil, and ensure full legal and statutory compliance for our Brazilian entity. This is a critical role requiring a deep understanding of LATAM labor markets, corporate governance, and a hands-on approach to business operations.Key Responsibilities 1. Local Corporate Representation & Administration (Brazil) Act as the official, named Local Representative for the company’s legal entity registration in Brazil. Liaise with local authorities, public agencies, notary offices (Cartórios), external legal counsel, and accountants to maintain the company’s good standing. Manage and oversee all local corporate administrative tasks, including processing legal documentation, managing corporate mail, and maintaining statutory records. Ensure strict compliance with Brazilian corporate laws, municipal regulations, and licensing requirements.2. Regional HR Operations (LATAM) Oversee and manage the day-to-day HR lifecycle operations for employees and contractors across Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Mexico. Lead local onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a seamless experience aligned with global standards and regional requirements. Partner with centralized or regional payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely monthly payroll processing, benefits administration, and tax filings in all four jurisdictions. Maintain accurate digital employee records and ensure compliance with local data privacy laws (such as LGPD in Brazil).3. Compliance & Labor Relations Monitor and interpret labor law updates and regulatory changes across Brazil (CLT), Colombia, Costa Rica, and Mexico to mitigate organizational risk. Manage local benefits programs (e.g., health insurance, meal vouchers, life insurance) ensuring competitive and compliant offerings in each country. Support employee relations issues, inquiries, and grievances, providing culturally nuanced and legally compliant guidance.Required Qualifications & Skills Experience:Minimum of 4–7 years of experience in HR Operations / People Operations, with at least 2 years managing multi-country scopes across LATAM. Confira a vaga para Técnico em planejamento - tubulações em barueri. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Nossa missão é entregar amelhor tecnologia para purificação de biogáscom o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado. Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medidade acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes. Fabricação e assistência técnica locaisresultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência. Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam aredução da complexidade e de custos. Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração deenergia limpa e sustentávelpara a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.Objetivo do Cargo:O(a) profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, controle e acompanhamento das atividades de assistência técnica nos ativos dos projetos, assegurando que os atendimentos sejam realizados com eficiência, qualidade e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.Atribuições: Planejar obras com foco em tubulação, incluindo cortes, soldas, montagem de tubulações, skids e interligações entre equipamentos. Atuar no planejamento técnico de projetos para implantação de plantas de biometano. Planejar ações de assistência técnica e definir estratégias de mobilização de recursos (mão de obra, materiais e equipamentos). Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas técnicos integrando fornecedores, instaladores e equipes internas. Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e garantir comunicação eficaz entre equipes multidisciplinares. Acompanhar a execução dos serviços em campo, assegurando qualidade, segurança e cumprimento de prazos. Emitir relatórios técnicos e dashboards de acompanhamento. Realizar follow-up com fornecedores e terceiros para garantir entregas no prazo. Apoiar a padronização de processos e documentação técnica. Tratar não conformidades e acompanhar ações corretivas no período inicial de operação dos ativos.Requisitos: Formação técnica ou superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Projetos Industriais ou áreas correlatas. Vivência em planejamento e execução de projetos industriais (de preferência no setor de energia, gás, petróleo, biogás/biometano). Conhecimentos em cronogramas, ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project, Primavera, Excel avançado ou similares). Familiaridade com processos de comissionamento, start-up e assistência técnica em campo. Boa capacidade de organização, comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar. Experiência mínima de 3 anos em planejamento de obras, preferencialmente com foco em tubulação.Benefícios Regime de contrato CLT. Salário competitivo ao do mercado. Vale transporte. Vale refeição. Plano de saúde. Plano Odontológico Seguro de vida

title: Ip lawyer (in-house, brazil)
description:
Confira a vaga para Ip lawyer (in-house, brazil) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Hello!We are looking for an experienced and proactive IP Lawyer to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil. This is a remote-first position, offering flexibility while working closely with our international legal and business teams. However, the role requires regular attendance at court hearings, enforcement actions, and raids in São Paulo. Therefore, candidates must reside in the city of São Paulo or its metropolitan area.You'll work directly on protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands through a combination of civil, criminal, and administrative IP enforcement. The position focuses on hands-on IP enforcement, including drafting and sending claims, managing pre-litigation negotiations, coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities, representing clients in civil and criminal proceedings, and recovering monetary compensation from infringers.Who are we?Brand Monitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries such as fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations. Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA, and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in Brazil.What you will do:Identify and monitor IP infringements throughout Brazil; Draft and send cease-and-desist letters, legal claims, and negotiate settlements; Represent rights holders in pre-litigation, civil litigation, and criminal IP proceedings; Coordinate and participate in search and seizure operations (raids) and enforcement actions with local authorities (Police, Customs, Public Prosecutor's Office, regulatory agencies, etc.); Draft and file powers of attorney, affidavits, criminal complaints, petitions, and litigation documents; Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies, courts, investigators, and service providers; Recover monetary compensation through settlements or court decisions; Support the company's legal and business operations in Brazil (contracts, compliance, office setup, banking, and corporate matters, as needed).What we expect from you:Law degree and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB); Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Intellectual Property (either in-house or at a law firm); Proven experience with IP enforcement, including: Civil litigation; Criminal IP matters, including search and seizure actions, criminal complaints, anti-counterfeiting investigations, and interactions with police and prosecutors; Experience coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities; Strong legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills; Fluent Portuguese and professional English (written and spoken); Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently in a global environment; Must reside in São Paulo (city or metropolitan area) due to the need for in-person attendance at courts, hearings, and enforcement operations.What We Offer:Work with top-tier global clients and international teams; Competitive salary; Opportunity to lead and shape Brand Monitor's legal operations in Brazil; Remote-first work environment with flexibility; Meaningful impact in the global fight against counterfeiting and intellectual property violations; Career growth within a fast-growing international legal-tech company.

Em um cenário de alta demanda por produtos biológicos mais robustos, seguros e escaláveis, a empresa busca fortalecer sua capacidade de PD&I em vacinas veterinárias. O projeto tem como foco o desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para bovinos, contemplando desde as etapas laboratoriais de cultivo celular e viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização até a validação pré-clínica e clínica dos produtos. Se você tem formação em Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Engenharia Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas, e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos para saúde animal, essa oportunidade é para você. Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e inovador, com conhecimento em formulação, estabilidade, purificação, UF/DF e integração de etapas produtivas, preparado para contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para a indústria veterinária. Projeto: Desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para prevenção de doenças respiratórias e reprodutivas em bovinos. Planejar e executar estudos experimentais avançados, com foco na otimização e controle de processos (Qb D). Desenvolver e aprimorar etapas críticas do processo, com destaque para liofilização, garantindo estabilidade e viabilidade do produto. Atuar no escalonamento de bioprocessos, assegurando reprodutibilidade, robustez e desempenho em ambiente industrial. Aplicar e desenvolver métodos analíticos (PCR, titulação viral, ensaios biológicos) para garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade dos resultados. Integrar diferentes etapas produtivas (cultivo celular, replicação viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização) de forma consistente e eficiente. Analisar dados experimentais utilizando ferramentas estatísticas e transformar resultados em insights técnicos. Elaborar relatórios técnicos para suporte à tomada de decisão e atividades regulatórias. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente de inovação aplicada. Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos, vacinas ou bioprocessos. Conhecimento prático em cultivo celular e/ou replicação viral. Experiência com técnicas analíticas, como PCR, titulação viral ou ensaios biológicos. Vivência em planejamento experimental e análise de dados científicos. Capacidade de comunicação técnica e elaboração de relatórios consistentes. Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Liofilização aplicada a produtos biológicos. Formulação e estudos de estabilidade de vacinas ou biofármacos. Escalonamento de processos (scale-up) e transferência de tecnologia para ambiente industrial. Técnicas de purificação, como ultrafiltração e diafiltração tangencial (UF/DF). Aplicação de Quality by Design (Qb D) no desenvolvimento de processos. Definição e controle de parâmetros críticos (CPPs) e atributos de qualidade (CQAs). Validação analítica e estudos de biocomparabilidade. Uso de ferramentas estatísticas avançadas (ex.: Design of Experiments – Do E). Experiência com requisitos regulatórios e geração de documentação técnica Perfil colaborativo, com capacidade de atuação em times multidisciplinares e projetos complexos. title: Qc - manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Qc - manager em vargem grande paulista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Oversee all analytical testing activities to ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, ANVISA RDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and traceability throughout all operations, maintaining the laboratory in a state of inspection readiness. Ensure robust method transfer processes are in place and executed effectively, collaborating closely with R&D, manufacturing, and third-party contractors. Drive the timely release of analytical results within schedules while maintaining stringent quality standards. Manage the acquisition, qualification, calibration, and maintenance of all QC laboratory equipment and instrumentation. Oversee the entire process for chemicals, reagents, and reference standards management, from procurement to disposal, ensuring supply chain integrity and compliance. Establish and maintain robust quality systems within QC, including OOS/Deviation management, CAPA effectiveness, change control, and risk management. Provide strategic direction for complex method troubleshooting, OOS investigations and other quality related process. Forecast and manage the departmental budget, including staffing, equipment, consumables, and external services. Develop and implement the strategic vision and operational plans for the QC department, aligning with the company overall business objectives and quality goals. Actively participate in internal and external regulatory audits (e.g., ANVISA, client audits), providing expert responses and presenting laboratory data and processes. Act as a primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all QC-related discussions during internal and external audits. Lead the preparation and response to audit findings, ensuring timely and effective CAPA implementation and closure. Stay abreast of new and evolving pharmaceutical regulations and industry best practices, ensuring the QC department remains fully compliant. Establish and monitor departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency, compliance, and quality improvements. Oversee recruitment, training, performance management, and career development for all QC personnel. Ensure adequate staffing levels and competencies to meet operational demands and future growth. Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, identify training needs, and support the professional development of team members. Promote a strong safety, continuous improvement and proactive problem-solving culture within the laboratory, ensuring all team members adhere to EHS policies and procedures. Collaborate effectively with other departments such as Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and Project Management to ensure seamless operations and achieve company goals. Participate in management review meetings, product development teams, and other cross-functional committees as required.

title: Field service engineer – latin america
description:
Nova oportunidade para Field service engineer – latin america em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Based in São Paulo, Brazil | Full-time | Extensive regional travelPosition SummaryAV Flexologic B. V. is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join its global Service & Support division, based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role provides on-site installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair services for AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Central America. The successful candidate will work closely with the Service & Support coordination team (Alphen aan den Rijn, Netherlands) and the Monterrey and Bangkok offices to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across the region.Engagement structureThis role is structured as an independent contractor engagement: the engineer will operate through their own Brazilian legal entity (CNPJ / "PJ" — pessoa jurídica) and issue a monthly invoice (nota fiscal) to AV Flexologic for services rendered, rather than being hired as a CLT employee.Key Responsibilities- Perform installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and repair of AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites. - Diagnose and resolve technical issues in the field, escalating to engineering or product specialists as needed. - Travel regularly within the São Paulo area and across Brazil, as well as to Argentina, Chile, and Central America, for scheduled and emergency service visits. - Provide clear, timely reporting on service visits, parts usage, and customer feedback to the Service & Support coordination team. - Maintain professional communication with customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders in Portuguese, Spanish, and English. - Support training of local customer technicians where applicable. - Maintain assigned company equipment (vehicle, tools, laptop, phone) in good working order.Travel RequirementsThis is a field-based, travel-intensive role. Expected travel coverage includes:- São Paulo metropolitan area and state (base region, most frequent travel) - Other regions of Brazil, as service demand requires - Argentina and Chile - Central America ("Middle America")Travel frequency will vary by season and customer install base; candidates should expect travel for a significant portion of working time, including multi-day international trips. A valid passport and the ability to obtain visas/work authorizations for the above countries is required.Candidate Requirements- Technical degree or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, or industrial engineering (or equivalent hands-on field service experience). - Prior experience in field service, industrial equipment maintenance, or a similar customer-facing technical role. - Fluent Portuguese (native/near-native) and working proficiency in English required; Spanish strongly preferred given Argentina/Chile/Central America coverage. - Valid driver's license; comfortable with frequent independent travel. - Strong troubleshooting mindset, customer service orientation, and ability to work autonomously in the field.Service Availability & Extra HoursExpected availabilityEquivalent to 40 hours per weekExtra hours beyond scopeAdditional hours may be billed as an extra line item on the monthly invoice, or offset with reduced availability in a following period, as agreed between the parties.Downtime & Public HolidaysAgreed annual downtime20–25 business days per year with no invoice reduction, by mutual agreement (contractual, not statutory)National public holidays9 fixed federal holidays, plus movable holidays (see list below) — no service expected, no invoice reductionBrazilian national (federal) holidays- January 1 – New Year's Day - April 21 – Tiradentes Day - May 1 – Labour Day - September 7 – Independence Day - October 12 – Our Lady of Aparecida (Patron Saint of Brazil) - November 2 – All Souls' Day - November 15 – Republic Proclamation Day - November 20 – National Black Consciousness Day (federal holiday since 2024) - December 25 – Christmas DayIn addition, Good Friday and Corpus Christi are movable, date-dependent observances, and Carnival (February/March) is technically an optional "ponto facultativo" day rather than a mandatory holiday — in practice, it is observed by the vast majority of Brazilian employers. State and municipal holidays (e.g., São Paulo city/state-specific dates) may add further non-working days depending on exact work location. On request holidays can be traded for work days in mutual agreement.Compensation (Monthly Invoice)Monthly invoice amount (indicative)Based on experience levelTravel expensesCovered by AV Flexologic for company travel.Equipment Provided

title: Técnico(a) de assistência técnica i
description:
Confira a vaga para Técnico(a) de assistência técnica i em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca deTécnicos(as) de Assistência Técnica Ipara atuar diretamente nas máquinas instaladas em nossos clientes, garantindo um serviço de qualidade e dentro dos padrões técnicos estabelecidos pela SIG. Se você atende aos requisitos da posição,reside em qualquer local do Brasil com proximidade a aeroportose possui disponibilidade para viagens, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade. Confira mais sobre esta posição e candidate-se:Principais responsabilidadeExecutar atividades de manutenção corretiva e preventiva nas máquinas e grupos construtivos, conforme documentações técnicas e padrões de qualidade. Relatar as anomalias encontradas na operação das máquinas que possam comprometer o processo produtivo, a segurança e causar quebras. Realizar reuniões com a equipe técnica de produção, gerência e/ou diretoria do cliente para apresentar as anomalias e traçar planos de ação para melhoria ou correção. Garantir o funcionamento seguro das máquinas, cumprindo os procedimentos de segurança para o produto e para as pessoas. Manter as condições básicas das máquinas através do controle e execução das rotinas de manutenção. Executar análise de falhas graves ou reincidentes nas máquinas e processos SIG, utilizando ferramentas de qualidade para identificar causas raízes e neutralizar anomalias. Comunicar os responsáveis pelo processo produtivo sobre anomalias encontradas, apoiando na tomada de decisão sobre a interrupção ou não da produção. Prestar suporte aos técnicos das máquinas (Cliente e SIG) na execução de manutenções corretivas para sanar dúvidas técnicas específicas. Programar paradas de produção para a execução de trabalhos corretivos em itens fora de padrão ou que apresentem riscos de segurança e qualidade. Orientar o operador de máquina com informações sobre as mudanças ocorridas nos processos de modificação dos equipamentos.Suas habilidades, experiência e formaçãoCurso técnico / Tecnólogo / Engenharia completo em mecânica, elétrica, eletromecânica, automação e mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas. Desejável ter conhecimento nas máquinas SIG e habilidade com atividade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva nas máquinas e grupos construtivos. Preferência: Morar perto (até 1:30) de um aeroporto.O que nós oferecemos Vale Refeição Vale Alimentação Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológico PPR Seguro de Vida Previdência Privada Wellhub Subsídio a estudos (conforme política) Licença paternidade e maternidade estendida Salário compatível com mercado.Competências da SIG Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.Nosso Compromisso A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.

title: Tax & billing analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Tax & billing analyst em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Join Micro Port and become part of a global healthcare company committed to advancing innovative medical technologies that improve patients' lives around the world. As our business continues to grow in Brazil and across Latin America, we are looking for a Tax & Billing Analyst (Mid-level) to join our Finance team in São Paulo.In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring tax compliance and supporting the complete revenue cycle, from customer master data and billing processes to revenue recognition and accounts receivable. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy combining technical expertise, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic multinational environment.Key Responsibilities✔ Manage tax compliance and support statutory tax obligations. ✔ Coordinate billing activities and issue tax invoices across different sales channels. ✔ Ensure accurate revenue recognition in accordance with company policies and accounting standards. ✔ Support accounts receivable activities and collection processes. ✔ Maintain customer master data and commercial conditions in SAP. ✔ Participate in financial projects, process improvements, regulatory initiatives, and system enhancements. ✔ Support internal and external audits.What We're Looking For✔ Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. ✔ Solid experience in Tax, Billing, or Revenue processes. ✔ Experience with SAP and advanced Excel. ✔ Intermediate English. ✔ Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, organization, and a hands-on approach.
